mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDPC1 (demand) over the next 20 trading days signals stronger economic activity, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in UNRATE above 4.5% in the next month signals weakening labor market conditions, prompting risk aversion and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the following 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive despite UNRATE crossing above 4.5%, or the trigger does not occur.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS falls below 4% AND GDPC1 grows by over 2% in the next month, accommodative monetary policy and robust demand create favorable conditions for positive S&P 500 forward returns within 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 4% and GDPC1 growth > 2% in next month
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative despite the interaction occurring, or the trigger does not materialize.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a sustained rise in FEDFUNDS above 4.3% triggers higher discount rates on equity cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive despite FEDFUNDS rising above 4.3% in the tightening regime, or the trigger does not occur.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in INDPRO (supply) over the next 60 trading days reflects improved production capacity, boosting corporate profits and equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are negative despite sustained supply growth, or the growth does not meet the 2% threshold.

mechanism_narrative: A short-term surge in HOUST (demand) above 50 units in the next month signals immediate consumer demand expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST rises >50 units in next month
failure_condition: 5-day returns are negative despite HOUST exceeding 50 units, or the surge does not occur.

mechanism_narrative: When PAYEMS (labor employment) increases by over 5k persons AND UNRATE falls below 4.5% in the next month, a strong labor market and low unemployment create confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns within 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises >5k persons and UNRATE falls <4.5% in next month
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative despite the labor market strengthening, or the interaction does not occur.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a drop in INDPRO below 108.5 (2% decline from recent levels) signals potential overcapacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are positive despite INDPRO declining >2% in the late-cycle regime, or the drop does not occur.
